events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80, on the anniversary of his passing.

angles.name: Queen's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty years on, and Freddie Mercury's voice still gives us chills. A true icon, gone too soon, but never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their musical evolution.

angles.name: Timeless Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative today as it did back then.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86, on the anniversary of his passing.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: His music inspired generations. Thinking of John Lennon, who would have been 86 today, and his enduring message of peace and love.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary David Bowie, who would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty years since a Starman was born. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years ago, the world welcomed Elvis Presley. His music still reigns supreme, a true legend of rock and roll.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, who turns 83 today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the legendary Jimmy Page! Still inspiring guitarists worldwide with those iconic Led Zeppelin riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Eighty-two and still rocking! Happy Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson), who turns 66 today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing ska-pop joy for decades. What's your top Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the soulful British singer Paul Young, who turns 71 today.

angles.name: 80s Soul Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' is a timeless classic. What's your favourite of his hits?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who turns 81 today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Eighty-one years young and still shining! Happy Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton. An absolute icon.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow, who turns 56 today.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That hits to solo success, a true British music legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the Grammy-winning British-Trinidadian singer Billy Ocean, who turns 77 today.

angles.name: Caribbean King
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to Billy Ocean! Still 'Suddenly' he's making us want to dance. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: The first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in 1989, honouring music's greatest pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock and roll history was made with the first Hall of Fame induction. Who would you have inducted first?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of Take That member Mark Owen, who turns 55 today.

angles.name: Take That's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop in London in 1969.

angles.name: Legendary Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary musician Phil Collins, who turns 76 today.

angles.name: Genesis & Solo Star
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, a true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the beloved British actor Hugh Grant, who turns 67 today.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to Hugh Grant! Still the king of charming awkwardness on screen. What's your favourite Hugh film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the pop superstar Justin Timberlake, who turns 46 today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the iconic British actor Sir David Jason, who turns 87 today.

angles.name: Only Fools & Horses Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, a true acting legend.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Tribute
events.blurb: Marks the anniversary of the tragic 1959 plane crash that claimed the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, music lost three incredible talents. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the iconic 80s singer Rick Astley, who turns 61 today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' remains an absolute classic.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since Bob Marley was born. His message of 'One Love' continues to resonate globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, who turns 85 today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius whose music has shaped generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic vocalist Whitney Houston, who would have been 64, on the anniversary of her passing.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Her voice was pure magic. Remembering Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 today, and her incredible legacy.

events.title: Take That's Original Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Marks 31 years since Take That originally announced their split in 1996, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: The Day The Music Stopped
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back 'for good' now!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of UB40 frontman Ali Campbell, who turns 68 today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine & Reggae
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Ali Campbell! The distinctive voice of UB40, still bringing those reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the global superstar Ed Sheeran, who turns 36 today.

angles.name: Chart-Topping Talent
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, a phenomenal British talent.
